tooltip.tsautocraft.blocking: Blocking mode: only push a pattern again once none of its ingredients are left in the machine. Off: crafters get more sets of the same recipe stacked on top.
tooltip.tsautocraft.mode: Click for the next mode. Crafting: via minecraft:crafter, fixed slot order. Processing: any machine, free amounts. Smelting: furnace, blast furnace or smoker.
tooltip.tsautocraft.load: Load the pattern in the top slot for editing (happens by itself when you put an encoded pattern in)
tooltip.tsautocraft.substitutes_on:
Substitutes: ON
Crafting patterns also accept other items the recipe allows at a position (e.g. any planks).
tooltip.tsautocraft.substitutes_off:
Substitutes: OFF
Crafting patterns only accept exactly the items in the grid.
tooltip.tsautocraft.view_tree: Show the recipe tree as a graph (drag to move, mouse wheel to zoom, click a node to collapse/expand it; +/- zoom, Home centers, Enter starts)
tooltip.tsautocraft.tab.history: Finished and cancelled jobs of the network
msg.tsautocraft.jei.requester_full: All Requester entries are in use
msg.tsautocraft.jei.provider_full: All pattern slots are in use
msg.tsautocraft.request.too_fast: Too many requests, try again in a moment
msg.tsautocraft.request.no_cpu: No Autocrafting Terminal on this network
reason.tsautocraft.no_target: no machine/crafter in front of provider
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.tsautocra: Unofficial addon for Tom's Simple Storage: Exporter, Importer, Pattern Provider, Pattern Terminal, Autocrafting Terminal and Requester.
tooltip.tsautocraft.exporter: Pushes filtered items from the network into the inventory it faces.
tooltip.tsautocraft.importer: Pulls items from the inventory it faces into the network. No filter = everything.
tooltip.tsautocraft.pattern_provider: Holds 9 patterns and supplies every crafter and machine around it, one after the other. A redstone signal only goes to the one that just got its items.
tooltip.tsautocraft.pattern_provider_con: Pattern Provider in connector form. Supplies the machine or crafter it faces.
tooltip.tsautocraft.pattern_terminal: Storage terminal that also encodes crafting and processing patterns.
tooltip.tsautocraft.autocrafting_termina: Runs crafting jobs. Request in any terminal on the network: Ctrl + click a craftable item (green +).
tooltip.tsautocraft.pattern_access_termi: Shows the patterns of every Pattern Provider on the network: insert, take out and swap them from one place.
tooltip.tsautocraft.requester: Keeps up to 6 items stocked by crafting them automatically.
tooltip.tsautocraft.capacity_upgrade:
Autocrafting Terminal: more parallel jobs.
Pattern Provider: 9 more pattern slots (up to 3).
tooltip.tsautocraft.speed_upgrade:
Importer/Exporter: halves the interval.
Pattern Provider: one more delivery per tick, shorter crafter cooldown.
Level Maintainer: halves the check interval.
tooltip.tsautocraft.stack_upgrade:
Importer/Exporter: 4x more items per operation.
Pattern Provider: 4x more crafts per delivery.
tooltip.tsautocraft.crafting_upgrade: Exporter: crafts filter items that are missing in storage.
tooltip.tsautocraft.crafting_emitter: Redstone signal on all sides depending on an item: below/above an amount, or while a job needs it (makes the item craftable, e.g. by a farm).
msg.tsautocraft.encode.no_smelting: No furnace recipe for this item
msg.tsautocraft.encode.no_brewing: No brewing recipe: reagent top middle, 1-3 bottles in the bottom row
tooltip.tsautocraft.craft_possible: Plan the largest amount that can be crafted right now
msg.tsautocraft.request.missing_possible: Missing items, but %s can be crafted now
tooltip.tsautocraft.emitter.below: Redstone signal while the network holds less than the amount.
tooltip.tsautocraft.emitter.above: Redstone signal while the network holds at least the amount.
tooltip.tsautocraft.emitter.craft: The item becomes craftable. Redstone signal while a job needs it (e.g. to switch a farm on). Bring the items back with an Importer.
label.tsautocraft.no_providers: No Pattern Provider on the network
lock.tsautocraft.off.desc: Deliver whenever the machine accepts the inputs (blocking mode applies).
lock.tsautocraft.until_result.desc: After a delivery, the machine gets nothing more until its results have come back through an Importer (or the lock timeout from the config has passed).
lock.tsautocraft.redstone_high.desc: No deliveries while the provider gets a redstone signal.
lock.tsautocraft.redstone_low.desc: No deliveries while the provider gets no redstone signal.
tooltip.tsautocraft.provider_priority:
Priority: providers with a higher priority get the crafts of a pattern first.
Shift-click: steps of 10
jade.tsautocraft.buffered: %s items waiting to go back into storage
io_mode.tsautocraft.round_robin.desc: Exporter: the next filter slot after the last one that moved items. Importer: the next slot of the inventory.
io_mode.tsautocraft.priority.desc: Always the first filter slot (top left first) / inventory slot that works.
io_mode.tsautocraft.random.desc: A random filter slot / inventory slot each operation.
io_mode.tsautocraft.blacklist.desc: Imports everything except the filtered items.
config.tsautocraft.title: Tom's Storage Autocrafting
config.tsautocraft.crafterTrigger.desc: How a filled crafter crafts: your own redstone circuit, a direct block tick, or a redstone pulse from the provider.
config.tsautocraft.enableDisabledCrafter: On: inputs go to the pattern's exact positions and re-enable disabled slots. Off: the recipe is moved to enabled slots.
Minimum ticks between two deliveries to the same crafter.
config.tsautocraft.crafterPulseTicks.des: Redstone pulse length in redstone mode, also how long the provider front lights up.
config.tsautocraft.crafterStuckTicks.des: Direct/redstone mode: a crafter still holding foreign items after this many ticks is emptied into the network.
config.tsautocraft.providerLockTimeoutSe: Lock mode "until result returned": a machine is unlocked after this many seconds even if its results never came back (0 = never).
Cancelling a job puts its inputs that still wait in crafters (not triggered yet) and, where clearly identifiable, in machine input slots back into the network.
config.tsautocraft.maxJobsPerTerminal.de: Parallel jobs of one terminal without upgrades.
config.tsautocraft.jobsPerCapacityUpgrad: Additional jobs per Capacity Upgrade in an Autocrafting Terminal.
config.tsautocraft.maxRequestAmount.desc: Largest amount one request may ask for.
config.tsautocraft.jobResultTimeoutSecon: A waiting job ends after this many seconds without any result coming back.
config.tsautocraft.jobIdleSeconds.desc: Without Importer reports: a waiting job ends after this many seconds without the stock rising.
config.tsautocraft.jobHistorySize.desc: Finished/cancelled jobs of the network an Autocrafting Terminal keeps in its history (0 = off, max 100).
config.tsautocraft.requesterCheckTicks.d: How often a Requester checks its stock.
config.tsautocraft.requesterMaxBatch.des: At most this many items per Requester job; the rest follows in the next round.
config.tsautocraft.requesterReplanSecond: A Requester job that waits this long for missing ingredients is planned again.
tooltip.tsautocraft.level_maintainer: Keeps up to 12 items stocked: crafts a batch whenever the stock drops below the threshold.
tooltip.tsautocraft.maintainer.threshold: Threshold: a job starts when the stock drops below this amount (0 = off)
tooltip.tsautocraft.maintainer.batch: Batch: how many items one job crafts (0 = off)
msg.tsautocraft.jei.maintainer_full: All Level Maintainer entries are in use
How often a Level Maintainer checks its stock; halved per Speed Upgrade.
config.tsautocraft.maintainerReplanSecon: A Level Maintainer job that waits this long for missing ingredients (with nothing in flight) is planned again.
config.tsautocraft.ioItemsPerOperation.d: Items moved per Importer/Exporter operation (at most one stack).
config.tsautocraft.ioIdleMaxSkip.desc: An Importer/Exporter that found nothing to move skips up to this many operations (one more per idle operation). 0 = never.
config.tsautocraft.craftablesSyncTicks.d: How often Tom's terminals refresh the list of craftable items.
tooltip.tsautocraft.crafting_emitter_dir: Like the Crafting Emitter, but the signal only goes out of the front (place it facing the block to power).
tooltip.tsautocraft.redstone_upgrade:
Importer/Exporter: works only with or without a redstone signal, or toggles on every pulse (button in the GUI).
Pattern Provider: gives the machine a redstone pulse after every delivery.
Level Maintainer: starts jobs only with or without a signal, or toggles on every pulse.
tooltip.tsautocraft.redstone.high: Redstone: works only with a signal
tooltip.tsautocraft.redstone.low: Redstone: works only without a signal
tooltip.tsautocraft.scale.mul: Multiply all input and output amounts by %s
tooltip.tsautocraft.scale.div: Divide all input and output amounts by %s
tooltip.tsautocraft.scale.too_big: Not possible: an amount would exceed %s
tooltip.tsautocraft.scale.not_divisible: Not possible: every amount must stay a whole number of at least 1 (divide by %s)
tooltip.tsautocraft.scale.empty: Put items into the grid or outputs first
tooltip.tsautocraft.guide_book: Right click to read how autocrafting works.
tooltip.tsautocraft.brewing.fuel: Fuel (optional): only delivered when the stand's fuel slot is empty, not counted per brew
msg.tsautocraft.encode.no_brewing_fuel: Top left is the fuel slot: this item is not a brewing fuel
label.tsautocraft.tree.title: Recipe tree: %sx %s
tooltip.tsautocraft.memory_card: Shift + right click on a block: copy its settings. Right click on a block of the same type: apply them (filter items and upgrades are taken from your inventory). Shift + right click into the air: clear.
msg.tsautocraft.memory_card.empty: The card is empty (shift + right click on a block to copy)
command.tsautocraft.reload.failed: Could not read config/tsautocraft.json, keeping the current values
msg.tsautocraft.jei.provider_only: Too many inputs for the Pattern Terminal: use the "+" of a Pattern Provider
command.tsautocraft.testsetup: %s test stations built south of you:
tooltip.tsautocraft.job.cancel_confirm: Click again to cancel the job
tooltip.tsautocraft.history.clear_confir: Click again to clear the history
